The screen is built at `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`.

Summary of what it does:
- An accessible combobox search input (ARIA combobox/listbox pattern) with mock topic suggestions filtered as you type, matched substring bolded.
- Arrow Up/Down moves through suggestions, Enter selects the active one (or free-types a search), Escape closes the dropdown, mouse hover/click also works without stealing input focus.
- Selecting a suggestion shows a results section: a summary line and a grid of six benefit cards, each with name, category pill, one-line description, and an Eligible/Not eligible badge.
- One suggestion ("Veteran and military benefits") intentionally has zero mock results to demonstrate the no-results empty state; any unmatched free-text search also falls into that state.
- A "New search" button resets back to the empty search view.

Since I couldn't inspect `@strata/react`'s actual component API (no `node_modules` installed in this sandbox and I kept work scoped to this folder), I built the UI with plain semantic HTML/CSS rather than importing unverified components, and styled it with Strata CSS variables (`var(--strata-color-*)`, `var(--strata-space-*)`, etc., all with sane fallbacks) plus logical properties so it holds up across brands, dark mode, and the RTL locale.
